jobs.description_text: AI Singapore (AISG) is a national initiative driven by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), and the National Research Foundation, Singapore (NRF). AISG brings together Singapore-based research institutions and the broader ecosystem of AI start-ups and companies to support impactful research, develop talent and power Singapore's AI efforts. For more information on AI Singapore, please visit https://www.aisingapore.org . This position will be hosted at the Nanyang Technological University (NTU) under VP (Artificial Intelligence & Digital Economy)’s office and we welcome you to join our community. We are seeking an Assistant Manager / Senior Executive, Programme Management to support the AI Apprenticeship Programme (AIAP) for Industry, coordinating programme activities, stakeholder engagement, and documentation for a national initiative that develops AI talent for industry. Key Responsibilities: Support the planning, coordination and delivery of the AI Apprenticeship Programme and related programme activities. Develop and maintain programme schedules, timelines, milestones and operational plans to ensure activities are delivered in a timely manner. Coordinate programme activities across different stages of the participant journey, including recruitment, onboarding, programme delivery, assessments and completion. Monitor programme progress and follow up on outstanding activities, deliverables and dependencies. Identify and flag potential operational issues, delays and programme risks to the relevant stakeholders for timely follow-up and resolution. Support end-to-end participant recruitment activities, including outreach, application administration, selection coordination and candidate communications. Coordinate onboarding activities and ensure participants receive the necessary information and administrative support before programme commencement. Support marketing and outreach initiatives to increase awareness of the programme and attract suitable applicants. Coordinate and engage with internal and external stakeholders to support effective programme delivery and address operational matters. Job Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities, timelines and priorities concurrently. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with participants, internal teams and external partners. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Prior experience supporting grant-funded or government-related programmes would be an advantage. Exposure to the technology, Artificial Intelligence (AI), training or talent-development sector would be an advantage. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: The Air Traffic Management Research Institute (ATMRI) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, was established in 2013 through a collaboration between NTU and the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS). Its mission is to conduct cutting-edge research in air traffic management (ATM) to support Singapore's position as a leading air hub and drive innovation in the Asia-Pacific region. ATMRI focuses on modernizing and harmonizing regional airspace operations to sustain the rapid growth of air transportation in the region. Its strategic research areas include artificial intelligence and data analytics for ATM, urban aerial transport systems, regional ATM modernization, exploratory studies on emerging technologies, and talent development through PhD programs. The institute aims to generate world-class ATM research, find innovative solutions, and catalyse transformation in the field. It plays a pivotal role in advancing the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of air traffic management systems. We are looking for a Senior Research Engineer to lead and support systems integration and prototyping activities in air traffic management (ATM), with a focus on the design, development, implementation, and integration of ATM systems and decision-support tools. The role will involve leading the development and integration of software components, research algorithms, data interfaces, and simulation platforms into functional prototypes, as well as overseeing system testing, verification, and validation in realistic ATM environments. The successful candidate will also provide technical guidance to research engineers, coordinate system integration efforts with research teams and industry partners, and contribute to the advancement of ATM research and innovation at Nanyang Technological University. Key Responsibilities: Lead and undertake research and development activities related to systems integration and prototyping for air traffic management (ATM) studies and applications. Design, develop, implement, and integrate software components, research algorithms, data interfaces, and decision-support tools into functional ATM system prototypes. Lead the design and implementation of system architectures, interfaces, and integration frameworks to ensure interoperability, scalability, and reliability across ATM research components and simulation platforms. Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and industry partners to translate research concepts and algorithms into integrated prototype solutions for current and future ATM concepts. Plan, coordinate, and conduct system integration, testing, verification, troubleshooting, and validation to evaluate the functionality, performance, reliability, and interoperability of developed prototypes. Oversee the integration and processing of operational and simulated data sources, external systems, and communication interfaces required for ATM research and experimentation. Lead and support the setup, operation, maintenance, and demonstration of integrated research prototypes and simulation environments. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and researchers, supporting knowledge transfer and the adoption of good software engineering and system integration practices. Prepare and review technical reports, system documentation, research outputs, and project deliverables, and contribute to technical discussions, project meetings, and reviews. Contribute to research publications, technical documentation, prototype demonstrations, and other project-related activities as required. Required Educational Qualifications, Experience, Skills and Competencies: Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Air Traffic Management, Transport, or other related fields. At least 5 years of relevant research, engineering, or development experience in systems integration, software development, systems engineering, prototyping, or related technical roles. Strong knowledge and practical experience in systems integration and prototyping, including software and data interfaces, interoperability, and integration of multiple software or research components into functional systems. Good written and oral communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical reports, system documentation, and research outputs, and communicate technical concepts effectively to multidisciplinary stakeholders. Strong proficiency in programming and software development using languages such as Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience in software integration, API development, data processing, or simulation platforms. Experience in system architecture design, system testing, debugging, verification and validation, software version control, and collaborative software development practices. Knowledge of air traffic management systems, aviation operations, simulation environments, or related decision-support systems would be advantageous. Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to independently develop technical solutions, troubleshoot complex system integration issues, and make sound technical decisions. Demonstrated ability to lead technical development activities, coordinate system integration efforts, and provide technical guidance to junior engineers or researchers. Strong interpersonal, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary research and engineering teams, manage multiple technical tasks, and deliver project outcomes within defined timelines. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

Strong programming proficiency in C++ and Python, with hands-on experience in ROS/ROS2 and Linux environments. Excellent technical writing skills, proactive problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative research team. OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with a deep expertise in autonomous AI agent architecture and deployment, to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of intelligent agent systems on our global crypto exchange platform. This is a senior role requiring a hands-on AI science background combined with strategic oversight, technical direction, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will work at the cutting edge of AI and crypto, designing AI agents that can autonomously reason, act, and evolve in complex, real-time environments such as trading, security, compliance, and customer interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of autonomous AI agents tailored to crypto exchange operations (e.g., customer assistant, trading bots, risk detection agents, fraud prevention agents, etc.).
  • Architect multi-agent systems (MAS) and frameworks to support goal-directed, reasoning, planning, and reinforcement-learning-based agents.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, business, and operation teams to define agent roles and measurable KPIs.
  • Drive experimentation, simulations, and continuous learning pipelines for agent performance optimization.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on developments in AGI, LLM-integrated agents, and cognitive architectures; apply relevant innovations to production systems.
  • Mentor and lead a team of AI scientists and engineers; help define the AI roadmap and research strategy.
  • Ensure system scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of AI-powered solutions in the crypto exchange domain.

What We Look For In You

  • PhD or Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Robotics or related field with at least 10 years of industry experience.

  • Proven experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in live environments. Ideal candidates will have:
    • Designed multi-agent frameworks or agent ecosystems (e.g., AutoGPT, OpenAgents, LangGraph, LangFuse, Dify, Coze, etc.).
    • Experience with goal-oriented agents, context engineering, memory management, tool use, and RL-based decision making.
    • Developed agents for real-time decision-making, such as trading, gaming, customer support, or operations.
    • Track record of delivering end-to-end AI systems in fast-paced, high-scale environments (preferably finance, crypto, or high-frequency domains).

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in top-tier AI labs or Tech industry leaders
  • Experience in high-frequency trading, fintech, Web3, or crypto platforms is a strong advantage
  • Startups or research-intensive environments preferred; must be comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
